title: SettingsClient.set / ipfsDesktop.agentSettings.set
description: Messages of the SettingsClient.set() method (agent-settings-contract task 1.5). On the Desktop bridge this is the IPC channel ipfsDesktop.agentSettings.set; on HTTP it is PUT on the settings route with revision presented as If-Match (mcp-agent-settings-api 1.2). Partial update: only present fields change. This method carries no secret material by design: api_key is refused here so that the single secret write path is setApiKey/clearApiKey (on Desktop, safeStorage; see set-api-key.schema.json). A write that changes the model host to one not already in the calling principal's egress_ack must carry egress_confirmation naming exactly that host (D4); on Desktop the bridge additionally requires Touch ID for that change (desktop-agent-settings-bridge 1.4). The response on success is the applied read shape with the new revision, identical to GetResponse in get.schema.json; failures reject with the settings error shape (../settings-error.schema.json).

revision.description: The current revision as returned by get() or a previous mutation. Maps to the HTTP If-Match header; a missing or stale value is rejected with revision_conflict (412).

system_prompt.description: Replacement for the custom part of the system prompt. The fixed safety prefix is always prepended by the server and cannot be removed, emptied or overridden by this value.

SetRequest.description: Partial update. minProperties 2 means at least one field besides revision must be present.

revision.description: The new revision after the apply.

SetResponse.description: The applied state, identical in shape to GetResponse (get.schema.json). The apply is synchronous and restart-free (ADR-0009 section 1); there is no job id and no restartRequired field.

kind.description: Switch the backend kind (openai: OpenAI-compatible endpoint; uar: Universal Agent Runtime, D14).

base_url.description: New backend base URL. Never carries credentials. A change to a host not already acknowledged needs egress_confirmation.

BackendSet.description: Like the server BackendWrite (../settings-write.schema.json) but with no api_key field: secrets go through setApiKey/clearApiKey only, so the Desktop bridge has exactly one secret write path into safeStorage.

ApiKeyStatus.description: Key presence and provenance only, mirroring ../settings-read.schema.json. Never carries key material.

custom.description: The operator-configured part of the system prompt.

host.description: The exact newly chosen model host the caller confirms it may send node content to (D4). It must equal the host of the base_url in the same write; any other egress change is rejected with egress_confirmation_required.

EgressConfirmation.description: Required exactly when the write changes the model host to one not already in the calling principal's egress_ack. Extends egress_ack for this host only. Mirrors ../settings-write.schema.json.
